items.title: Show HN: Acceptodds a prediction market on which ICLR 2027 papers get accepted
items.contentSnippet:
Hi, I built acceptodds, a prediction market on conference peer review. Every ICLR 2027 submission (42k papers) has a market: Accept vs. Reject.
Like many in the ML community, I think the current conference/paper situation is a bit broken. I'm not sure how to fix it, but this is my attempt at building something fun to get the conversation started.
Some details:
- Prices come from Hanson's LMSR (logarithmic market scoring rule).
- You can sell and/or rebuy at any time
